name: Rydoo
description:
Rydoo MCP connects your AI assistant to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — your assistant can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.

Ask your assistant to pull up expenses, check on trips, or clarify policy questions, and get answers instantly without switching tools or digging through menus.

Key features:
- Read and analyse spend — search expenses you own or oversee by date, status, category, group, person or trip, pull up a single expense with a link into Rydoo, find card expenses still missing a receipt, and get server-computed totals per trip, person or project.
- Process approvals — see what's waiting on you, then approve or reject an expense using your company's reject reasons. Every action is confirmed with you first and recorded under your name.
- Answer questions — expense-policy Q&A: what's reimbursable, which limits apply, and similar.
- Look up company records — find the right category, branch, group, person or trip to filter expenses by, and check your own roles, modules and currencies.
- Review trips — look up trips and bookings you own or oversee, and tie expenses back to them.
- Manage cards and wallets — list cards you hold, approve or oversee as finance, review matched and unmatched card transactions, check wallet balances, spend summaries and monthly statements, and request a virtual card with the limit you confirm. Requires the Rydoo Cards module.
- Send feedback — report a bug or request a feature straight to Rydoo.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rydoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rydoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rydoo.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rydoo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rydoo lists 20 MCP tools, including list_expenses, get_expense, ask_policy_assistant, approve_expense, reject_expense, list_wallets, list_cards, list_card_transactions, get_wallet_spend_summary, list_wallet_monthly_statements, request_virtual_card, and find_trip.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rydoo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rydoo in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Rydoo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rydoo is developed by Rydoo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
